notes: Requires a Gezel build with MOSS-Image support and stable-diffusion.cpp master-973 or newer (Gezel pins master-975-95b3090). Use 50 steps, CFG 3, Euler, and dimensions divisible by 16; 1 to 2 megapixels is the upstream recommendation. The engine applies MOSS's time shift of 5 and its layer-22 skip on the negative guidance branch by itself. The tokenizer is passed separately because Qwen3.5's vocabulary differs from the one the engine embeds. The VAE is the FLUX.2 small decoder, the one the upstream pipeline ships and the same file FLUX.2 Klein uses. Text-to-image only. Not yet tested end to end in Gezel; memory and speed are unmeasured.
